text: {"lessons":["I have tended to sell positions after gains; I should not take profits just to lock in a win, but decide based on each stock’s prospects and my portfolio plan.","My average cost is not a reason to hold a losing position or avoid admitting a mistake; I should reassess it objectively and manage losses by the same rules as gains.","Since past price changes do not predict future moves, I should avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations and use a consistent, planned review and rebalancing schedule."]}
